items.originalTitle: What the US GP really exposed about where Ferrari is lacking
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc said it was a "shame" that Ferrari "came short of winning" after finishing runner-up at the United States Grand Prix, and team principal Fred Vasseur acknowledged the team lost time in the final two laps of Q3.
detailZh: 勒克莱尔在美国大奖赛获得亚军后的言论，完美概括了法拉利2026赛季F1征程的许多方面。
他说，"我们未能夺冠"令人"遗憾"。
奥斯汀站典型地体现了法拉利今年的一个反复出现的主题：练习赛全程强劲，排位赛早期有竞争力，Q3表现令人失望，正赛中追赶，但往往为时过晚，无法拿下胜利。
领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔并未否认这一评价。
他说：“我认为这个周末进展顺利，升级套件的一切都按预期工作。但问题在于，从FP1第一圈到正赛最后一圈，我们所有圈都跑得不错，唯独两辆车在Q3的最后两圈例外。那大概就是我们有所欠缺的地方。”
美国大奖赛不仅对法拉利，也对所有在前方竞争的车队凸显了一点：如果一切没有做到完美，排位赛中损失最小的时间也可能决定整个周末的成败。
勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在发车格上位列第四和第五，无论从最终名次还是对正赛希望的影响来看，这都令人失望。
然而汉密尔顿第五快的圈速，距离维斯塔潘用来让自己占据头排发车位的成绩，仅差0.097秒。
正如瓦塞尔所说：“我们不必下结论，因为我们是第五名，距离第一名只有0.3秒。这不算灾难。你可能是第五名，但距离第二名0.8秒。”
定义法拉利周末的差距，并非底盘/引擎组合缺少根本性的东西；而是在Q3等关键时刻未能充分挖掘其全部潜力。
而在不让千分之一秒溜走这件事上，并非所有因素都能控制，这也是法拉利并非唯一遇到的问题。
许多车手在美洲赛道Q3的第二轮尝试中都难以提升，迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯认为他的赛车足够快，可以排到第二，但最终只排在第八位（部分原因是违反了赛道限制）。
瓦塞尔补充道：“确实如此，就赛车和轮胎而言，工作窗口非常狭窄。一旦你稍微偏离，很快就会损失两到三成。”
“如今在F1中，对于前八名来说，两到三成可能意味着六个名次的变化。这意味着，一阵风、出圈时稍微滑得太多，或者不得不减速过多并保持节奏，都可能让你从超级成绩跌至一无所有。”
众所周知，法拉利赛车的特性使其在排位赛中比其他车队更难让轮胎进入工作状态，因此勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在寻找理想工作温度甜区时总是困难得多。
如果像奥斯汀那样乌云密布、温度哪怕只下降几度，他们的头疼可能会加剧。勒克莱尔表示，这在Q3中的影响对他来说就像“白天与黑夜”的差别，甚至出圈的感觉都截然不同。
不过这不仅仅是轮胎的问题，因为汉密尔顿在美国大奖赛周末的调校选择上付出了代价。
他在第一节练习中未能迅速进入状态，在第二节练习中走错了方向，此后尽管到周六早上情况有所好转，但他一直在追赶，试图找到一个前部有足够抓地力的平衡。
而且在正赛前没有调整到位，前轮在早期阶段过度磨损，使他追赶勒克莱尔的希望破灭。
“我认为我们只是一直没有调到最佳，不知为何，持续地没有调到最佳，”汉密尔顿说。
他只有在比赛最后一节时，才把赛车的平衡调到了接近所需的状态，但那时已经太晚，做不了什么了。不过如下图所示，他与勒克莱尔的差距被大幅缩小了。
回顾整场比赛中不断加大前翼角度，汉密尔顿说：“在进站期间，我加了四格。下一次进站，又加了四格，即便如此，我还是差了四格。”
“这太疯狂了，差了12格。我们真的需要研究一下是怎么走到这一步的。”
他补充道：“我觉得如果我能拥有我需要的平衡，哪怕只是在最后一节有那个平衡，我本可以一直战斗到最后。”
勒克莱尔本人认为，他成功调校到赛车上的设定——以及他对转向敏锐赛车的容忍度是众所周知的——是他取得进步的关键。
“这些赛车非常特殊且独特，我觉得在过去两三场比赛中，我在驾驶方面再次解锁了一些东西，尤其是在调校与我的驾驶风格相匹配方面，”他说。
奥斯汀的教训——法拉利需要在正确的时间做好一切——来得正是时候，因为车队开始为明年的赛车确定概念选择。
而这正是汉密尔顿全神贯注确保将自己的意见纳入其中的事情。
他说：“我认为这是一个关键节点，可以借此把赛车引向明年正确的方向。”
“所以我正在着力处理我们明年赛车需要改进的领域，这是本周末以及接下来几个周末讨论的一部分。”
法拉利不需要一场革命，就能找到如今让第三排和前排产生差距的进步。
更多动力会有帮助，但众所周知，法拉利为此牺牲了一部分动力，以换取更好的底盘性能。然而，就像第三节排位赛中正在发生的情况一样，细节将决定一切。
汉密尔顿补充道：“现在正是你真正需要做出决定的时候，并且要明确这些就是那些区域——如果你为明年把这些地方修正好，每个弯角就能快半成。”
“这些就是我们正在挣扎的区域。这就是我明年想要的空气动力学平衡。但问题并不是特别多。”
“我认为我们有一套非常好的套件，所以要保留赛车上的优点，并纠正这几处细微的差别，然后再看看直线速度的情况。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc's comments after finishing runner-up in the United States Grand Prix perfectly sum up much of Ferrari's 2026 Formula 1 campaign.
He said it was a "shame" that "we came short of winning".

Austin typified a bit of a running theme for Ferrari this year. Strong throughout practice, in contention early on in qualifying, underwhelming in Q3, recovering in the race but often leaving it too late to take the victory.
It is an assessment that team principal Fred Vasseur did not dispute.

"I think the weekend went well and everything is working as expected on the [upgrade] package," he said. "But the issue is that we did all the laps, from the first lap of FP1 to the last lap of the race, in good shape except the last two laps of Q3 on both cars. It's probably where we missed something."

What the US GP highlighted for not just Ferrari but all those fighting at the front is that, if everything is not nailed perfectly, the consequences from losing the smallest amount of time in qualifying can define weekends.
Fourth and fifth on the grid for Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton was a disappointment in terms of the final positions and the impact that would then have on their hopes for the race.
Yet Hamilton's fifth-fastest time was just 0.097 seconds off what Max Verstappen had been able to deliver to put himself on the front row.
As Vasseur said: "We don't have to draw a conclusion because we are P5 and we are three tenths off P1. It’s not a disaster. You can be P5 and be eight tenths off P2."
The deficit that defined Ferrari's weekend is not about a chassis/engine package lacking something fundamental; it’s about extracting the full potential from it in critical moments such as Q3.
And when it comes to not letting thousandths slip away, not all the elements can be controlled, and it's a problem that Ferrari is not alone in experiencing.

A lot of drivers struggled to improve on their second Q3 runs at the Circuit of the Americas, and McLaren's Lando Norris reckoned he had a car quick enough for second but ended up eighth on the grid (held back partly by a track-limits breach).
Vasseur added: "What is true is that with the cars and the tyres, the window is very narrow. And as soon as you are a bit out, quickly you lose two or three tenths.

"Today in F1 for the top eight, two or three tenths can be six positions. It means that you can move from a super result to nowhere for a gust of wind, or you slide a little bit too much in the outlap, or you have to slow down a bit too much and stick to your pace."

It's well understood that Ferrari's car characteristics make it harder for it to fire up the tyres for qualifying than others, so Leclerc and Hamilton always have a much tougher time finding that ideal sweet spot with operating temperatures.

And their headaches can increase if, as happened at Austin, the clouds come over and the temperature drops even just a few degrees. Leclerc said the impact of this in Q3 was like a "night and day" difference for him in terms of how even the outlap felt.
It is not just about tyres though, because Hamilton paid the price for set-up choices made over the US weekend.

He had not hit the ground running in FP1, went in the wrong direction in FP2 and from then on, although things were better by Saturday morning, was in catch-up mode as he chased a balance that had enough on the nose.
And having not gone far enough before the race, the front washing out too much in the early stages put paid to his hopes of matching Leclerc.
"I think we've just been under-hitting it, continuously under-hit it, for some reason," said Hamilton.

He only got his car anywhere near where he needed the balance to be for the final stint of the race, by which stage it was too late to do anything. But as the graphic below shows, the deficit to Leclerc was slashed considerably.

Reflecting on adding more and more front wing throughout the race, Hamilton said: "Through the pitstops, I added four clicks. The next pitstop, added another four clicks, and even then, I'm still another four clicks too short.
"It's crazy, like to be 12 clicks down. We really need to look in how we are getting to that point."
He added: "I think if I had had the balance that I need, even if I just had the balance in the last stint, I would have been right in the fight all the way to the end."
Leclerc himself felt that a set-up he has managed to dial into the car - and his tolerance with a pointy car is well-known - has been the key to progress he has made.
"These cars are very specific and unique, and I feel like, over the last two or three races, I've unlocked something again in terms of driving, and particularly set-up with my driving," he said.
The lesson from Austin that Ferrari needs to nail everything at the right moment comes at an important time as it begins committing to its concept choices for next year's car.
And this is something that Hamilton is laser-focused on ensuring he feeds his opinion into.
"I see a pivotal moment in terms of steering the car in the right direction for next year," he said.
"So I'm really working on areas that we need to improve for next year's car, so that's part of the discussion this weekend, the next couple of weekends."
It does not need a revolution for Ferrari to find the progress that is the difference these days between the third row and the front.

More power will help, but it's known Ferrari sacrificed some of that for better chassis performance. However, like with what is happening in Q3, it's the details that are going to count for everything.

Hamilton added: "This is the time where you actually start to need to make decisions and actually fall in line that these are the areas that if you fix these for next year it's half a tenth in every corner.
"These are the areas that we're struggling with. This is where I want the aero balance to be for next year. But there's not a huge amount of things.
"I think we've got a really good package, so it's keeping on the good things of the car and rectifying a couple of these small, subtle differences, and then see about the straightline speed."
keyPointsZh: 法拉利本站练习赛表现强劲，排位赛早期有竞争力，但Q3表现不佳，正赛追赶但常常为时过晚。
瓦塞尔表示，升级套件一切按预期工作，问题出在排位赛第三节最后两圈。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari was strong throughout practice and in contention early in qualifying, but underwhelming in Q3 and recovered in the race, often too late to win.
Vasseur said the upgrade package worked as expected, with the issue being the final two laps of Q3.

items.originalTitle: 'Lots to take away' - Hamilton reveals area he's 'lost out' to Leclerc
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said he has "lost out" to Charles Leclerc in the set-up of his Ferrari car in recent races, which has cost him performance. He finished fourth at the United States Grand Prix while Leclerc was second.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿表示，近期在F1比赛中，他的法拉利赛车调校不如勒克莱尔。
汉密尔顿觉得自己近期没有把法拉利赛车的调校做到最优，这让他损失了性能；汉密尔顿在周日的美国大奖赛获得第四，而勒克莱尔获得第二；本周五起，墨西哥城大奖赛的每一节练习与排位都将在天空体育直播。
克雷格·斯莱特对本站美国大奖赛发表看法：梅赛德斯车手安东内利强势夺冠，这位意大利车手只需在墨西哥大奖赛再拿两分，就能夺得历史性的首个世界冠军。
汉密尔顿表示，近期在法拉利赛车的调校上，他不如勒克莱尔。
在美国大奖赛中，勒克莱尔在排位赛中击败了汉密尔顿，汉密尔顿在正赛中无法匹配队友的惊人速度，最终获得第四名，而勒克莱尔则落后于分站冠军基米·安东内利获得第二名。
在上一站新加坡的比赛中，汉密尔顿在排位赛中表现强劲，直到第三节排位赛被勒克莱尔击败；奥斯汀站也出现了类似的情况，这位七届世界冠军在最后一次练习赛中排名第一，但最终只获得第五名。

“在过去五场左右的比赛中我丢了很多积分，”汉密尔顿对天空体育F1表示，他在车手积分榜上落后第二名乔治·拉塞尔一分。
“我认为问题出在赛车调校上，调校并不完美。这是我必须真正攻克的地方。我就是在这里吃了亏。就表现而言，我觉得自己一直开得很好，上一场[奥斯汀]的那段 stint 也不错。前两段 stint 我对此无能为力。
“肯定有很多需要总结的地方。车队做得很好，带来了升级。查尔斯拿到了第二名。我们有了不错的表现。希望去墨西哥时，我们能改进在调校上出错的地方。”
2026年美国大奖赛的精彩瞬间
法拉利在美洲赛道的大多数弯角中依然是标杆车队，但与梅赛德斯和红牛相比，缺乏直线速度。
但是，汉密尔顿对大奖赛前两段 stint 中赛车的低速平衡感到不满，这让他退出了领奖台的争夺。
“我损失了太多时间。尤其是在低速弯，我无法让赛车转向——1号弯、11号弯、12号弯、13号弯、14号弯、15号弯。严重的转向不足，所以当我调整设置时，[其他]赛车就拉开了距离，”他说。
“到我们进入最后一节时，我们更接近了平衡，但我们本应在开始时就用上那个平衡。学到了很多。车队在进站和策略方面做得非常出色。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿透露，他的法拉利赛车存在“严重”转向不足，这让他错失了美国大奖赛的第四名完赛。
勒克莱尔本可以赢得美国大奖赛吗？
勒克莱尔排位赛获得第四，但起步极为出色，在第一赛段超越了伊萨克·哈贾尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘，然而维斯塔潘在第一圈结束时又反超了这位法拉利车手。
法拉利为勒克莱尔选择了两次进站的策略，这让他在比赛尾声阶段超越了维斯塔潘和采用一次进站策略的兰多·诺里斯，但他最终落后安东内利13秒完赛。
勒克莱尔认为自己的排位赛名次让他错失了获胜机会，但即便他在正赛中遇到的交通状况更少，安东内利也“实在太快了”。
“如果你看看第一节、第二节和第三节练习，我们非常强。如果你看看排位赛，在第三节排位赛结束时，要让轮胎达到工作温度极其困难，我们很可能就是在那里失去了获胜的机会，”勒克莱尔说道。
“但基米非常强，所以，从整个周末来看，我认为我们就是不够稳健。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在奥斯汀的最后一节练习中力压马克斯·维斯塔潘排名第一。
法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔认为，在情况不同的前提下，勒克莱尔本可以赢得这场比赛。
“比赛进行得很顺利——竞速过程很顺利，速度还可以，我们在策略上很激进，因为我们必须超车，”瓦塞尔对天空体育F1表示。
“总的来说，如果说我们错过了什么，那就是Q3的最后两圈。那是这个周末最重要的几圈，问题就出在那里。
“总的来说，我想从周末中看到积极的一面，那就是从第一节练习到比赛最后一圈，速度一直都在。如果没有虚拟安全车，本来会是双领奖台，但我们还是争取在墨西哥跑出更好的排位赛并赢得比赛。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔对兰多·诺里斯和马克斯·维斯塔潘完成两次精彩超越
法拉利能在2026年再赢一场比赛吗？
2026赛季还剩五站，本周末首先进行墨西哥城大奖赛，由于赛道海拔2200米，海拔将成为影响因素。
法拉利动力单元在高海拔地区的表现将决定他们能否在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道争夺胜利，这条赛道拥有大量弯道，SF-26 应该会喜欢。
勒克莱尔表示：“差距非常细微，这也取决于其他车队在接下来比赛中的升级计划。但赛车的感觉越来越好。”
“这些赛车非常特殊且独特，我觉得在过去两三场比赛中，我在驾驶方面又解锁了一些东西，尤其是驾驶与调校的结合。两者结合在一起，我们向前迈出了一步，我对赛车的感觉舒服多了。”
“我希望这能很快带来一场胜利。无论是在新加坡还是奥斯汀，我们都非常接近，所以我有信心，我们会在赛季结束前有机会赢得一场比赛。”

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton reveals he's 'lost out' in recent F1 races with set-up of his Ferrari car compared to Charles Leclerc

Lewis Hamilton feels he's not optimised set-up of his Ferrari car recently which has cost him performance; Hamilton finished fourth in Sunday's US Grand Prix while Charles Leclerc was second; watch every session of the Mexico City GP from this Friday, live on Sky Sports

Craig Slater gives his verdict on the on United States GP, as a dominant win for Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli leaves the Italian needing just two points from the Mexico GP to claim an historic first world title
Lewis Hamilton has revealed he's "lost out" to Charles Leclerc through the set-up of his Ferrari car in recent races.

Hamilton was outqualified by Leclerc at the United States Grand Prix and was unable to match his team-mate's impressive pace in the race on his way to fourth, while Leclerc finished second behind race-winner Kimi Antonelli.

At the previous race in Singapore, Hamilton looked strong in qualifying until Q3 when he was beaten by Leclerc, and a similar pattern occurred in Austin where the seven-time world champion topped final practice, only to qualify fifth.
How Antonelli can win world title at Mexico City GP on Sunday
Mexico City GP Schedule | F1 2026 standings | F1 2026 calendar
Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
"I lost a lot of points in the last five races or so," Hamilton, who is one point behind second-placed George Russell in the Drivers' Championship, told Sky Sports F1.

"I think it has come from set-up, not perfect, the set-up. That's something I really have to get on top of. That's where I have lost out. Performance-wise I feel like I've been driving well and the last [race] stint [in Austin] was good. The first two stints there was nothing I could do about that.

"Definitely lots to take away. The team did a great job to bring an upgrade. Charles got a second place. We have got good performance. Hopefully when we go to Mexico, we can improve on where we have gone wrong on that setup."
Highlights from the 2026 United States Grand Prix
Ferrari continued to be the benchmark team in most corners at the Circuit of the Americas but lacked straight-line speed compared to Mercedes and Red Bull.
But, Hamilton was unhappy with the car's low-speed balance in the first two stints of the Grand Prix which put him out of the podium fight.

"I lost so much time. I couldn't turn the car in the low-speed particularly - Turn 1, Turn 11, Turn 12, Turn 13, 14, 15. Massive understeer so the [other] cars pulled away when I was adjusting my settings," he said.

"By the time we got to the last stint, we got closer to the balance but we should have started with that balance at the beginning. Lots of learnings. The team did a great job with pit stops and strategy."
Lewis Hamilton revealed that his Ferrari had 'massive' understeer, which cost him a fourth-place finish at the United States Grand Prix
Could Leclerc have won United States GP?
Leclerc qualified fourth but had a superb start by overtaking Isack Hadjar and Max Verstappen in the first sector, only for Verstappen to overtake the Ferrari driver at the end of the first lap.

Ferrari opted for a two-stop strategy with Leclerc which saw him charge past Verstappen and Lando Norris, who did a one-stop race, in the closing stages but he ultimately finished 13 seconds behind Antonelli.
Leclerc believes his qualifying position cost him a chance at victory but even if he had less traffic to contend with in the race, Antonelli was "just too quick".

"If you look at FP1, FP2 and FP3, we were very strong. If you look at qualifying, at the end of the day in Q3, it was extremely difficult to bring the tyres up to temperature, and we probably lost a shot at the victory there," said Leclerc.
"But Kimi was very strong, so, as a whole weekend, I think we're just not robust enough."
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice in Austin from Max Verstappen
Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur believes Leclerc could have won the race in different circumstances.
"The race went well - the racing went well, the pace was OK, we were aggressive with the strategy because we had to overtake," Vasseur told Sky Sports F1.
"Overall, if we missed something it was the last two laps in Q3. That was the most important laps of the weekend and that's where we had the issue.

"Overall, I want to take the positive of the weekend that the pace was there from FP1 to the last lap of the race. Without the VSC it would have been a double podium but let's try to do a better qualifying in Mexico and win the race."
Charles Leclerc makes two great overtakes on Lando Norris and Max Verstappen
Can Ferrari win another race in 2026?
Five rounds remain in the 2026 season with the Mexico City Grand Prix up first this weekend, where altitude will be a factor given the track is 2,200m above sea level.

The performance of the Ferrari power unit at altitude will dictate if they can challenge for victory at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, which features lots of twisty corners which the SF-26 should enjoy.
"It's such fine margins, and it also depends on what the upgrade plans of the others are in upcoming races. But the feeling with the car is getting better and better," said Leclerc.

"These cars are very specific and unique, and I feel like, over the last two or three races, I've unlocked something again in terms of driving, and particularly setup with my driving. Just both together, we've taken a step forward, and I just feel much more comfortable with the car.
"I hope that this will result in a win soon. Whether it's in Singapore or in Austin, we were quite close, so I'm confident that we'll have a shot to win a race before the end of the season."

致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术解析与比赛分析。
评论员娜奥米·希夫警告，红牛赛车调校窗口过窄，可能影响马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔2026赛季的一级方程式征程。
在美国大奖赛上，两位车手的比赛在开局阶段都遭遇了挫折。哈贾尔遇到了起步问题，这促使他要求重新设计离合器；而维斯塔潘在1号弯出弯时缺乏电力部署，这立刻让他陷入了与法拉利车队贯穿全场的缠斗。
在Up To Speed播客节目中，希夫认为比赛起步时的问题反映了米尔顿凯恩斯车队更广泛的问题。
希夫说：“很遗憾他们俩都没能顺利起步，因为我们本来很期待马克斯和基米之间的较量，而且伊萨克也在其中，这本来真的可能制造一点冷门，谁知道呢，说不定还能拿下他在一级方程式的首场胜利。”
“但整个周末那辆红牛，感觉除了离合器之外，还有很多地方需要审视。感觉那辆车真正有效的工作窗口并不大，而且真的处在刀刃边缘，这几年来一直如此。”
“我想，从今天一开始，对他们来说这更像是一场止损的比赛。而马克斯在最后也承认，也许他们从一开始制定的策略就不对。”
“我们也听到他在无线电里情绪相当激动，抱怨车队把他放回脏空气里，也许没有优化他们最终不得不采用的策略。但目前那辆车对那两位车手来说似乎都不太好驾驶。”
detailEn: Naomi Schiff warns Red Bull over "knife's edge" F1 car after US GP struggles
Naomi Schiff has raised concerns over Red Bull's narrow operating window
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Broadcaster Naomi Schiff has warned that Red Bull's narrow set-up window could be compromising Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar's 2026 Formula 1 campaigns.

At the United States Grand Prix, both drivers' races were derailed in the opening stages. Hadjar suffered a launch issue that prompted him to demand a clutch redesign, while Verstappen lacked electrical deployment out of Turn 1, which instantly dropped him into a race-long battle with the Ferraris.
Speaking on the Up To Speed podcast, Schiff argued that the problems at the start of the race are indicative of wider issues for the Milton Keynes outfit.

"It was such a shame that they both didn't get off the line there because it was a battle we were looking forward to between Max and Kimi, but then also Isack being in there could have really caused a little bit of an upset and potentially, who knows, clinched his first victory in Formula 1," Schiff said.

"But that Red Bull this whole weekend, it just feels like there's, besides the clutch, there's a lot that needs to be looked at. It feels like there's really not a very big operational window that works with that car, and that it's really on a knife's edge, as it has been for a number of years now.
"I guess it was more of a damage limitation race for them from the get-go today. And Max admitting at the end that maybe the strategy call that they had from the beginning wasn't right.

"We heard him over the radio being pretty passionate as well about them sending him back out into dirty air and maybe not optimising the strategy that they ended up having to go with. But that car just doesn't seem to be very easy to drive for either of those drivers at the moment."

items.originalTitle: Fred Vasseur reveals two costly moments that denied Ferrari US GP double podium
detailZh: 弗雷德·瓦瑟尔透露两起代价高昂的时刻，导致法拉利美国大奖赛错失双料领奖台
弗雷德·瓦瑟尔解释了Q3灾难和由凯迪拉克引发的晚些时候的VSC如何让法拉利失去了这个机会
对于法拉利车迷来说，这是最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，包括车手更新、技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远处的赛事反应
如果严格根据成绩单来看，美国大奖赛对法拉利来说是一个极为成功的周末。新升级的赛车拥有惊人的比赛速度，轮胎磨损完全在控制之中，查尔斯·勒克莱尔驾驶着他的赛车在梅赛德斯-奔驰的基米·安东内利之后取得了精彩的第二名
但是，在Scuderia车队的维修区里，有一种挥之不去的'如果'的感觉
如果这个周末在美洲赛车场的比赛中，只有两件事略有不同，法拉利老板弗雷德·瓦瑟尔坚信他们将会获得巨大的双料领奖台——甚至可能获得比赛的胜利
在他的赛后采访中，天空体育F1的记者特德·克拉维茨向瓦瑟尔建议，查尔斯·勒克莱尔实际上在不同的情况下有赢得比赛的潜在速度。不出所料，瓦瑟尔完全同意，将团队周六的表现视为周日问题根源
'可能吧，我认为今天一切都很顺利，一切都很好，速度也不错，我们在策略上很积极，因为我们必须超越对手，'瓦瑟尔解释说。'总的来说，如果我们错过了什么，那可能就是昨天Q3的最后两圈；我认为这可能是周末最重要的一圈，也是我们出现问题的地方。
因为在现代一级方程式赛车中，赛道位置绝对是王道，错过关键的Q3窗口意味着法拉利不得不在车流中烧胎挣扎，而安东内利则在前面享受着干净的空气。
尽管错过了胜利，法拉利在比赛的最后阶段积极追赶红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。刘易斯·汉密尔顿以惊人的速度追击着挣扎的小红牛22，为最后的领奖台位置准备了一场精彩的对决。
然后，最讽刺的事情发生了。
瓦尔特里·博塔斯遭遇机械故障，将他的凯迪拉克开到赛道边，引发了一场晚期的虚拟安全车，这完全中和了比赛，并保住了维斯塔潘的第三名奖杯。
Kravitz 幽默地指出法拉利的亮点：博塔斯的凯迪拉克使用的是法拉利动力单元，但由于汽车无法移动，显然是液压故障——这意味着不是法拉利部件爆炸。
尽管瓦瑟尔可能庆幸他的客户引擎没有爆炸，但VSC介入的时间对汉密尔顿来说却是毁灭性的。
瓦瑟尔承认，如果没有VSC，可能本可以拿到双料领奖台。他遗憾地表示，'他正在逼近，然后我不知道是第三还是第四名；我没有水晶球，但最终速度是有的。'
尽管错过了双料领奖台，瓦瑟尔离开德克萨斯州时对车队带到COTA的备受瞩目的空气动力学升级套件感到非常乐观。
“是的，一切还可以，但下周我们一定要做得更好，”瓦瑟尔总结道，完美地掩饰了巨大的速度提升。'“我们必须调整好一切，并再次回到这个状态，但让我们继续努力。”
“如果法拉利能清理掉他们的Q3执行问题，并避免更多不及时的凯迪拉克故障，他们将在下周周末的高海拔墨西哥大奖赛上成为绝对的威胁。”
detailEn: Fred Vasseur reveals two costly moments that denied Ferrari US GP double podium
Fred Vasseur explains how a Q3 disaster and a late VSC triggered by a Cadillac cost Ferrari a massive double podium
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

The United States Grand Prix was a wildly successful weekend for Ferrari, if you strictly go off the timing sheets. The newly upgraded car possessed blazing-fast race pace, tyre degradation was fully under control, and Charles Leclerc dragged his machine to a brilliant second-place finish behind Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli.
But inside the Scuderia garage, there is a lingering feeling of "what if."

If just two things had gone slightly differently this weekend at the Circuit of the Americas, Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur is convinced they would have secured a massive double podium—and potentially even the outright race victory.

During his post-race interview with Sky Sports F1, reporter Ted Kravitz suggested to Vasseur that Charles Leclerc actually had the underlying pace to win the race under different circumstances. Unsurprisingly, Vasseur completely agreed, pointing the finger at the team's Saturday performance as the root of their Sunday problems.

"Probably yes, I think that today it went well, everything went well, the pace was OK, we were aggressive with the strategy, because we had to overtake," Vasseur explained. "Overall, if we missed something, it's the last two laps in Q3 yesterday; I think it was the most important lap of the weekend probably, and it's where we had the issue."

Because track position is absolutely king in modern Formula 1, missing that critical Q3 window meant Ferrari had to burn their tyres fighting through traffic while Antonelli cruised in clean air at the front.

Despite missing the win, Ferrari was actively hunting down Red Bull's Max Verstappen in the closing stages of the race. Lewis Hamilton was reeling in the struggling RB22 at a rapid pace, setting up a blockbuster battle for the final podium spot.
And then, the ultimate irony struck.

Valtteri Bottas suffered a mechanical failure and pulled his Cadillac over to the side of the track, triggering a late virtual safety car that completely neutralised the race and saved Verstappen's third-place trophy.

Kravitz hilariously pointed out the silver lining for Ferrari: Bottas' Cadillac uses a Ferrari power unit, but because the car couldn't be moved, it was clearly a hydraulic failure—which means it wasn't a Ferrari part that exploded.
While Vasseur was likely relieved his customer engine didn't blow up, the timing of the VSC was devastating for Hamilton.

"Without the VSC, probably it would have been a double podium," Vasseur admitted, lamenting the lost opportunity. "He was closing, and then I don't know if it was P3 or P4; I don't have the crystal ball, but at the end of the day the pace was there."
Despite missing out on the double podium, Vasseur is leaving Texas feeling highly optimistic about the heavily scrutinised aero upgrade package the team brought to COTA.

"Yes, everything was OK-ish, but now for sure we have to do a better job next week," Vasseur concluded, perfectly downplaying the massive pace injection. "We have to fine-tune everything and to come back on this, but let's continue to push."
If Ferrari can clean up their Q3 execution and avoid any more poorly timed Cadillac breakdowns, they are going to be an absolute menace at the high-altitude Mexican Grand Prix next weekend.

致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
当你的明星车手拿下领奖台后走下赛车，随即在全球直播中直言维修区停站、轮胎和发动机制动全都糟糕透顶时，车队领队就得赶紧拿起最近的麦克风去灭火。
在美国大奖赛上维斯塔潘通过无线电大发雷霆之后，红牛车队首席执行官兼领队洛朗·梅基斯全面进入了公关危机管控模式。梅基斯没有把调校失误的责任推给工程部门，而是把矛头指向了某块不听话的碳纤维。
当马克斯·维斯塔潘抱怨选错了轮胎配方、还要应付糟糕的发动机制动时，梅基斯却声称，赛车在起步灯熄灭后仅仅几分钟就受了伤。
“马克斯的赛车在第8圈左右撞到了一些碎片，因此受了些损伤，”梅基斯在赛后接受媒体采访时表示。“除此之外，我们还有几个问题影响了平衡，结果就是速度掉了、轮胎衰退加剧，马克斯没能守住第二名。”
梅基斯承认，车队根本没有足够的火力去追赶分站冠军基米·安东内利，后者相对轻松地一路驶向得克萨斯的夕阳。
“可以这么说，尽管马克斯以第三名完赛、拿下本赛季第12个领奖台，我们离开奥斯汀时并不完全满意，”车队领队坦言。“今天我们失去了一些优势，我认为我们的速度不足以与基米抗衡，他跑了一场非常强劲的比赛，所以要向他表示祝贺。”
维斯塔潘并不是周日唯一在头盔里大喊的车手。他的队友伊萨克·哈贾尔因离合器故障遭遇了灾难性的起步，随后无线电完全失联，毁掉了他的进站策略。梅基斯没有回避这些机械故障，直接承认车队严重辜负了这位年轻车手。
“伊萨克的情况类似，他的比赛被起步以及比赛中的几个问题所拖累，”梅基斯承认。“起步再次不够完美，但车队正在努力确保我们拥有在未来解决这一问题的工具。”
红牛在 championship 中的一线希望
尽管两位车手都极其讨厌他们的赛车在美洲赛道上的操控表现，红牛实际上却带着一个绝佳的积分榜位置离开了这个比赛周末。
“这是一个充满挑战的周日，但我们会接受这个领奖台，因为我们知道今天没有完全发挥出赛车的潜力，我们会从本周末吸取经验，下周在墨西哥以更强的姿态回归，”梅基斯指出，随后强调了这一巨大的利好。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
“尽管如此，我们现在已经升至车队积分榜第三位，而马克斯在车手积分榜上距离第二名也仅差六分。”
如果红牛能找到办法阻止小红牛22过度消耗自身离合器，同时针对墨西哥城高海拔空气调校好空气动力学平衡，那么维斯塔潘就处于有利位置，有望在赛季结束前锁定积分榜第二名。
detailEn: Red Bull reveals damage behind Max Verstappen's US GP struggles
Laurent Mekies blames lap 8 debris for Max Verstappen's pace drop while promising to fix Isack Hadjar's clutch issues
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

When your star driver gets out of the car after grabbing a podium and immediately tells the global broadcast that the pitstops, tyres, and engine braking were all complete garbage, it is up to the team principal to jump on the nearest microphone and put out the fire.

Following Verstappen's radio meltdown at the United States Grand Prix, Red Bull Racing CEO and team principal Laurent Mekies went into full PR damage control mode. Instead of blaming the engineering department for botching the set-up, Mekies pointed the finger at some rogue carbon fibre.
While Max Verstappen complained about picking the wrong tyre compounds and dealing with awful engine braking, Mekies claimed the car was actually wounded just a few minutes after the lights went out.

"Max’s car hit some debris around lap eight and picked up some damage," Mekies stated while speaking with the media after the race. "On top of that, we had a few issues that hurt the balance and, as a result, the pace dropped off, the degradation increased, and Max couldn't hang on to second place."
Mekies admitted the team simply didn't have the firepower to chase down race-winner Kimi Antonelli, who drove off into the Texas sunset relatively unchallenged.

"It’s fair to say that, despite a 12th podium of the season with Max finishing third, we are leaving Austin not fully satisfied," the team principal confessed. "We lost a bit of our edge today, and I don't think we had enough pace to fight with Kimi, who had a very strong race, so well done to him."

Verstappen wasn't the only driver screaming into his helmet on Sunday. His team-mate Isack Hadjar suffered a catastrophic start due to a faulty clutch, followed by a total radio blackout that ruined his pit strategy. Mekies didn't shy away from the mechanical failures, directly acknowledging that the team severely let the young driver down.

"It was a similar story for Isack, whose race was compromised by the start and then by a couple of problems during the race," Mekies admitted. "Once again, the starts weren’t perfect, but the team is working to make sure we have the tools to fix that in the future."
The championship silver lining for Red Bull
Despite both drivers absolutely hating how their cars handled at the Circuit of the Americas, Red Bull actually walked away from the weekend in a fantastic mathematical position.

"A challenging Sunday, but we’ll take the podium knowing that we didn’t fully realise the potential of the car today, and we’ll take learnings from this weekend to come back stronger next week in Mexico," Mekies noted before highlighting the massive silver lining.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
"Despite all that, we have now moved up to third in the constructors’ championship, and Max is now only six points behind second place in the drivers’ championship.”

If Red Bull can figure out how to stop the RB22 from eating its own clutch while dialling in the aerodynamic balance for the high-altitude air in Mexico City, Verstappen is in prime position to claim P2 in the standings before the season ends.
